ProovStation reads a vehicle the way an industrial process inspects a part: exhaustively, objectively, every time the same way. A drive-through captures the full state of the body, the tires, the geometry. An AI trained on millions of real vehicles classifies, locates and grades every finding. A timestamped record lands in the operator's stack within seconds.

Founded on the conviction that vehicle inspection deserves the same rigor as the most demanding industrial processes. From day one, the same team has designed the scanners, trained the AI, and operated the network behind every vehicle we read.

From the steel of the scanner to the AI in the cloud, everything is designed, produced and operated by the same group. For you, that means one point of contact when something goes wrong, and one team accountable for the result.
The result is built-in reliability, technological sovereignty, and stations engineered for industrial lifespan rather than product cycles.
Every ProovStation station ever deployed has been produced on Atermes' industrial site in central France. Same line, same standards, same lifespan.
PROOVSTATION × ATERMES
Atermes has manufactured every ProovStation station produced to date. In 2026, after eight years of industrial partnership, ProovStation became a full part of the Atermes group.

Atermes is a French high-technology industrial group active in defense, industry and advanced technologies. The same engineering culture that delivers mission-critical hardware to worldwide industrial programs is what builds, ships and supports the ProovStation network.

The ProovStation inspection AI is trained exclusively on vehicles scanned in operational conditions: dealer service lanes, rental branches and parking facilities, logistics yards, fleet workshops. Not on lab footage, not on synthetic data.
Industrial production
Dealerships, rental, fleets, logistics, remarketing.
